title: Calculus Warm-up — Derivatives
description:
A quick check after **Lecture 2**. Covers the power rule, the chain rule and a bit of notation.

Good luck! 🎯

questions.explanation: By the power rule $\frac{d}{dx}x^n = n x^{n-1}$, so we get $3x^2$.

questions.text: Which of the following functions are **differentiable everywhere** on $\mathbb{R}$?
questions.explanation: $|x|$ has a corner at $0$, and $\sqrt{x}$ is not even defined for $x<0$.

questions.question:
What does this Python snippet print?

```python
f = lambda x: x ** 2
h = 1e-6
print(round((f(3 + h) - f(3)) / h))
```

questions.text: Let $f(x) = x^2 + 3x$. What is the slope of the tangent line at $x = 1.5$?
If $f$ is differentiable at $a$, then $f$ is continuous at $a$.
questions.explanation: Differentiability implies continuity — but not the other way around (think $|x|$).
